2: A Psalm of David, `To cause to remember.' Jehovah, in Thy wrath reprove me not, Nor in Thy fury chastise me.
3: For Thine arrows have come down on me, And Thou lettest down upon me Thy hand.
4: Soundness is not in my flesh, Because of Thine indignation, Peace is not in my bones because of my sin.
5: For mine iniquities have passed over my head, As a heavy burden--too heavy for me.
6: Stunk--become corrupt have my wounds, Because of my folly.
7: I have been bent down, I have been bowed down--unto excess, All the day I have gone mourning.
8: For my flanks have been full of drought, And soundness is not in my flesh.
9: I have been feeble and smitten--unto excess, I have roared from disquietude of heart.
10: Lord, before Thee is all my desire, And my sighing from Thee hath not been hid.
11: My heart is panting, my power hath forsaken me, And the light of mine eyes, Even they are not with me.
12: My lovers and my friends over-against my plague stand. And my neighbours afar off have stood.
13: And those seeking my soul lay a snare, And those seeking my evil Have spoken mischievous things, And they do deceits meditate all the day.
14: And I, as deaf, hear not. And as a dumb one who openeth not his mouth.
15: Yea, I am as a man who heareth not, And in his mouth are no reproofs.
16: Because for Thee, O Jehovah, I have waited, Thou dost answer, O Lord my God.
17: When I said, `Lest they rejoice over me, In the slipping of my foot against me they magnified themselves.
18: For I am ready to halt, And my pain is before me continually.
19: For mine iniquity I declare, I am sorry for my sin.
20: And mine enemies are lively, They have been strong, and those hating me without cause, Have been multiplied.
21: And those paying evil for good accuse me, Because of my pursuing good.
22: Do not forsake me, O Jehovah, My God, be not far from me,
23: Haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation!
